findings.location: Body, lines 42–43: final sentence describing every number as an exact model value in a finite-dimensional idealization.
findings.evidence: The assigned item ex-nrqm-many-body-gas-statistics-dilute-limits, clause (c), treats countably infinite mode families and their product partition sums. The page's finite-dimensional characterization does not cover that calculation. This B-page prose was outside reader edit scope.

findings.location: Proof 1.2, sentence claiming both error terms are positive (line 98).
findings.evidence: The same sentence gives q/(1+q)-q=-q²/(1+q), which is negative for every q>0, so its claim that both signed error terms are positive is false. The assigned consumer uses the identity; its repaired proof states the fermionic correction is negative and distinguishes its absolute value.
